sections.heading: 1. Four moves at home
lines: ① Sit to stand from a chair, 10 reps.
③ Side-lying leg lifts, 10 each side.
④ Step-ups on a low step, 10 reps.

sections.heading: 2. See your GP promptly if…
lines: You can't take weight after a fall, or
the joint is hot and swollen with a fever.

caption:
Hip stiff first thing, or after a long sit? Koko sighs every time she puts her socks on.

Hip osteoarthritis is a common change as we age, often felt as a groin ache or stiffness after sitting. The good news: current guidelines put exercise and education first, whatever your X-ray looks like.

Simple strength work like sit to stands, bridges and step-ups, two or three times a week, is a good place to start. Keep walking, cycling or swimming, and shorten the distance if the ache hangs around past the next day.

Pain after a fall or a hot swollen joint should be checked by your GP. Our Sydney CBD physios can help you get started. Book online via the link in bio 🐨
